content:
{
  "findings": [
    {
      "title": "Safety endpoints lack stated analysis",
      "quote": "Incidence and severity of adverse events, with severity determined according to the NCI CTCAE v5.0",
      "page": 35,
      "section": "Table 4",
      "category": "completeness",
      "severity": "major",
      "explanation": "The safety endpoints (AEs, ECOG, vital signs, labs) are listed in Table 4 but no corresponding statistical analysis is described in Section 9.3.",
      "fix": "Add a subsection under 9.3 describing the analysis of safety endpoints (e.g., descriptive statistics, incidence rates, change from baseline)."
    },
    {
      "title": "Primary endpoint analysis changed to descriptive without formal estimand",
      "quote": "the analysis of PFS will only be reported in a descriptive manner. No formal testing will be performed.",
      "page": 81,
      "section": "9.1",
      "category": "consistency",
      "severity": "major",
      "explanation": "The protocol states the primary endpoint will be analyzed descriptively, but the estimand attributes (population, variable, intercurrent events, summary measure) are not fully specified for this descriptive analysis.",
      "fix": "Provide a complete estimand for the descriptive PFS analysis, including the summary measure (e.g., median, Kaplan-Meier curve) and handling of intercurrent events."
    },
    {
      "title": "Missing handling of intercurrent events for PFS",
      "quote": "Start of subsequent anticancer therapy before disease progression as assessed by investigator or death. To be evaluated for progressive disease and survival.",
      "page": 83,
      "section": "Table 7",
      "category": "completeness",
      "severity": "major",
      "explanation": "The table lists 'start of subsequent anticancer therapy' as a situation but does not specify a clear strategy (e.g., treatment policy, hypothetical) for the primary estimand; it says 'to be evaluated' which is ambiguous.",
      "fix": "Specify the estimand strategy for intercurrent events such as subsequent therapy (e.g., treatment policy strategy) and how it affects the analysis."
    },
    {
      "title": "No analysis specified for key secondary endpoints",
      "quote": "ORR, defined as the proportion of participants with a CR or a PR on two consecutive occasions ≥4 weeks apart, as assessed by investigator according to RECIST v1.1",
      "page": 35,
      "section": "Table 4",
      "category": "completeness",
      "severity": "major",
      "explanation": "ORR and OS are key secondary endpoints but Section 9.3 does not describe their statistical analysis methods (e.g., how ORR is compared, OS analysis).",
      "fix": "Add analysis descriptions for ORR and OS, including statistical methods and handling of missing data."
    },
    {
      "title": "Missing analysis for additional efficacy endpoints",
      "quote": "DOR, defined as the time from the first occurrence of a documented objective response to disease progression or death from any cause (whichever occurs first), as assessed by investigator according to RECIST v1.1",
      "page": 35,
      "section": "Table 4",
      "category": "completeness",
      "severity": "major",
      "explanation": "DOR, CBR, and DCR are listed as additional secondary endpoints but no analysis methods are described in Section 9.3.",
      "fix": "Include analysis methods for DOR, CBR, and DCR (e.g., Kaplan-Meier for DOR, proportions for CBR/DCR)."
    },
    {
      "title": "Sample size determination lacks updated inputs",
      "quote": "Originally, the sample size of this study was determined by the primary endpoint; therefore, the study was event driven.",
      "page": 81,
      "section": "9.2",
      "category": "completeness",
      "severity": "major",
      "explanation": "The section describes the original sample size but does not provide the actual inputs (e.g., assumed hazard ratio, alpha, power, event numbers) or justify the new descriptive approach with any sample size considerations.",
      "fix": "Provide the original sample size assumptions and clarify whether any sample size re-estimation is needed for the descriptive analysis."
    },
    {
      "title": "Inconsistent statement about primary endpoint analysis",
      "quote": "The primary analysis of PFS will be analyzed in the intent-treat (ITT) population.",
      "page": 83,
      "section": "9.3.2",
      "category": "consistency",
      "severity": "minor",
      "explanation": "This statement implies a formal primary analysis, but Section 9.1 says PFS will only be reported descriptively. The inconsistency may confuse readers.",
      "fix": "Revise to state that PFS will be analyzed descriptively in the ITT population."
    },
    {
      "title": "Missing multiplicity control for secondary endpoints",
      "quote": "a control for the overall type I error (α) applying a gate-keeping hierarchical sequential testing method will no longer be implemented.",
      "page": 81,
      "section": "9.2",
      "category": "completeness",
      "severity": "minor",
      "explanation": "The protocol states no formal testing will be performed, but if any descriptive p-values are reported, it is unclear how multiplicity is handled; also, no mention of adjustment for secondary endpoints.",
      "fix": "Clarify that no formal multiplicity control is needed due to descriptive analysis, or specify if any adjustments are applied."
    }
  ]
}
